Insertion of new section 34-A, XLV of 1860

An Ordinance further to amend the
Pakistan Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 3rd June, 1984]
No. F. 17(1)-Pub.-The following Ordinance
made by the President is a hereby published for general information :-
2. Insertion of new section 34-A, XLV of 1860.--In the Pakistan
Penal Code (Act XLV of 1860), after section 354, the following new section
shall be inserted, namely :-
"354-A.
Assault or use of criminal force to woman and stripping her of her
clothes.-Whoever assaults or uses criminal force to any women and strips her of
her clothes and, in that condition, exposes here to the public view, shall be
punished with death or with imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to
fine.
